summary: Roland diagnosed a duplicate launchd service causing multiple conflicting instar processes to spawn. A rogue plist in /Library/LaunchDaemons was spawning duplicate instar-boot processes that interfered with relay connections.
actions: Verified instar server status and log line count
Identified two separate instar-boot processes with different PIDs running simultaneously
Located duplicate plist at /Library/LaunchDaemons/ai.instar.Roland.plist conflicting with user agent
Began sudo removal of duplicate launchd daemon
learnings: Duplicate launchd services in both user and system directories cause process spawning conflicts that break service functionality
Check both ~/Library/LaunchAgents and /Library/LaunchDaemons directories for duplicate or shadowing service definitions
